Chilliwack Proper East offers established neighborhood charm with mature trees, quality schools, and the family-oriented atmosphere that attracts dedicated homebuyers. This well-maintained area features tree-lined streets with diverse housing from character homes full of charm to renovated properties with modern updates, many on larger lots with established landscaping.

Residents appreciate proximity to local schools, walkability to parks and recreation facilities, plus the genuine community connections where neighbors know each other by name. The area provides convenient access to shopping, diverse dining options, and services meeting daily needs locally without long drives. Despite the established character, properties remain well-cared for reflecting pride of ownership throughout these neighborhoods. Central location means quick access to outdoor recreation including Cultus Lake and Chilliwack River, while Highway 1 makes Fraser Valley commuting practical. blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Chilliwack Proper East

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Chilliwack Proper East are served by McCammon Traditional Elementary, Robertson Elementary, Little Mountain Elementary, Chilliwack Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Portage Park, Gwynne Vaughan Park (heritage gardens at 46181 Hope River Road), the Chilliwack Cultural Centre, Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, and Townsend Park. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 51, Route 53 (Fairfield), and Route 57 (Broadway) connecting Prest Road, Broadway, and Yale Road to the Downtown Chilliwack Exchange.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Chilliwack Proper East

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Chilliwack Proper East are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 5500) small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) and urban infill rules, plus Fraser/Chilliwack River floodplain construction levels. Before removing subjects on a property in Chilliwack Proper East, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper East Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in Chilliwack Proper East?

Active MLS® listings in Chilliwack Proper East typically include detached single-family houses on 6,000 to 8,000 sq ft lots (including homes with R1-A duplex or R1-B small-lot subdivision potential), infill townhomes, and basement-entry houses with suites. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Chilliwack Proper East in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Chilliwack Proper East include McCammon Traditional Elementary, Robertson Elementary, Little Mountain Elementary, Chilliwack Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Chilliwack Proper East?

Residents of Chilliwack Proper East have access to Portage Park, Gwynne Vaughan Park (heritage gardens at 46181 Hope River Road), the Chilliwack Cultural Centre, Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, and Townsend Park. See our
Chilliwack Proper East Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Chilliwack Proper East?

Key road corridors serving Chilliwack Proper East include Yale Road, Williams Street, Prest Road, First Avenue, Broadway Street, and Highway 1 Exit 123 (Prest Road). Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 51, Route 53 (Fairfield), and Route 57 (Broadway) connecting Prest Road, Broadway, and Yale Road to the Downtown Chilliwack Exchange.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Chilliwack Proper East?

Properties in Chilliwack Proper East are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 5500) small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) and urban infill rules, plus Fraser/Chilliwack River floodplain construction levels. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Chilliwack Proper East freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Chilliwack Proper East are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
